from flask import Flask, request, make_response import html import re app = Flask(__name__) # Search functionality with result highlighting @app.route('/search') def search(): query = request.args.get('q', '') page = request.args.get('page', '1') # Basic length check if len(query) > 500: return 'Query too long', 400 # Sanitize page parameter try: page_num = int(page) except ValueError: page_num = 1 # Fetch results (simulated) results = perform_search(query, page_num) # Build response with search context response_html = build_results_page(query, results, page_num) resp = make_response(response_html) resp.headers['Content-Type'] = 'text/html; charset=utf-8' return resp def perform_search(query, page): # Simulated search results sample_results = [ {'title': 'Getting Started Guide', 'snippet': 'Learn how to get started with our platform...'}, {'title': 'API Documentation', 'snippet': 'Complete API reference for developers...'}, {'title': 'FAQ', 'snippet': 'Frequently asked questions about our service...'}, ] return sample_results def build_results_page(query, results, page_num): # Escape query for display in most places escaped_query = html.escape(query) results_html = '' for r in results: # Highlight matching terms in snippets highlighted_snippet = highlight_terms(r['snippet'], query) results_html += f'''

{html.escape(r['title'])}

{highlighted_snippet}

''' # The search suggestion feature uses the raw query in a JavaScript context # to provide "did you mean" functionality via client-side processing page_html = f''' Search Results - {escaped_query}

Search Results

Showing results for: {escaped_query} (Page {page_num})

{results_html} ''' return page_html def highlight_terms(text, query): # Only highlight alphanumeric terms to prevent injection via snippets terms = re.findall(r'\w+', query) for term in terms: pattern = re.compile(re.escape(term), re.IGNORECASE) text = pattern.sub(f'{html.escape(term)}', text) return text @app.route('/api/suggest') def suggest(): query = request.args.get('q', '') # Simple suggestion logic suggestions = [] if len(query) > 3: suggestions = [query + ' guide', query + ' tutorial', query + ' examples'] return {'suggestions': suggestions} if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080)

environment.description: Same Flask application on ECS Fargate. Task definition includes linuxParameters with dropped capabilities (CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE removed). Container uses read-only root filesystem with tmpfs mount at /tmp. The ALB has an associated WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode which includes rules for detecting script injection patterns in query parameters and request bodies via JavaDeserializationRCE, Log4JRCE, and CrossSiteScripting_QUERYARGUMENTS rules. The CrossSiteScripting_QUERYARGUMENTS rule uses AWS's built-in XSS detection signatures that inspect all query string parameters for common XSS vectors including script tags, event handlers, and JavaScript protocol URIs. Container security context also sets noNewPrivileges=true.
